description: Aménagements bus en Île-de-France is a dataset listed in Île-de-France Mobilités open data, an open data portal of a public transport authority, published or maintained by Île-de-France Mobilités. Couche géographique décrivant les aménagements bus (voies en site propre) en Île-de-France. Généalogie Ces données sont issues du crowdsourcing effectué par les contributeurs au projet OpenStreetMap et sont sous licence ODbL et la mention d'attribution doit être "© les contributeurs d'OpenStreetMap sous licence ODbL" conformément à. Coverage: France (network area of the operator or portal owner). It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal files it under Infrastructures, Plans. Its keywords are Bus, Collectivité. The portal shows 2022-03-21 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence ODbL Version Française (https://doc.transport.data.gouv.fr/le-point-d-acces-national/cadre-juridique/conditions-dutilisation-des-donnees/licence-odbl). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-idfm-open-data-portal.
